prompt: Create one elegant panoramic photographic hero asset for a premium but approachable European independent car showroom website. Wide 4:1 landscape banner composition, not a collage. It should have the quiet authenticity of an architectural editorial photograph, not CGI or a dramatic car advertisement. A small believable showroom on an overcast day: matte warm grey porcelain floor, off-white plaster walls, black slim window frames, simple natural furniture, soft diffuse daylight. A parked graphite estate car is partly visible at the far left; the front quarter of a pearl white premium SUV is visible at the far right, both realistically proportioned with coherent wheels, bodywork and reflections, low in the frame. The entire middle 50 percent must be a calm, light, nearly empty architectural wall with gentle texture and no objects, deliberately composed as safe negative space for centered black title, breadcrumb and two lines of copy. Keep every car and busy detail outside this text-safe centre. Give the photograph a little warmth and life through subtle wood and a small muted olive-green plant at an outer edge, without changing the overall neutral black, grey, white palette. Eye-level camera, modest 50 mm editorial lens feel, honest material texture, restrained reflections, a plausible ordinary physical space. Keep all essential composition in the central horizontal band so the asset can be cropped into a 1320 by 320 pixel website masthead. No people, no logos, no signs, no text, no branding, no fantastical building, no glowing lights, no bloom, no neon, no blue car, no orange accents, no sci-fi shapes, no exaggerated shine, no giant floating vehicles. High resolution.
